cards.text: MOTILLI — AI UGC YAPPER 01

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: Exact approved Motilli narration: 27 thought beats, H1 working opening, H2/H3 alternatives, approximately 4:34 pending voice alignment. ONE P01 HeyGen avatar drives the entire performance. Static screenshot, explanation, ingredient and product overlays are separate assets. Candid action B-roll covers selected lines. B17 and the close use the actual product cutout; the avatar never handles a product. Current replacement images are selected below; competitor frames stay in a separate reference lane.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: If you're backed up on a GLP-1 and eating less isn't helping, let me explain the gut slowdown nobody warned me about. Because once I understood it, everything changed.
Same HeyGen avatar · continuous performance

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: I was just scrolling through a GLP-1 support group on Facebook looking for answers and a gastroenterologist had left a comment on someone's post and it stopped me mid-scroll.
Support-group screenshot overlay

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Discovery / authority — Curious, recalling an ordinary scroll rather than announcing a breakthrough.

Show the discussion screenshot on “scrolling through a GLP-1 support group.” This is a static card overlay, not a phone video. Keep the HeyGen avatar visible; remove before the explanation. Keep its recreation label visible.
Underlying performance: one continuous HeyGen avatar from P01. Cue timing stays provisional until actual voice alignment.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: He said GLP-1 meds can slow down how fast your stomach empties. Like your stomach normally contracts to push food through, and when that slows down everything just backs up. Food, waste, gas. That's where the backed-up bloated feeling is actually coming from. It wasn't a weight thing at all. It was the gut slowdown.
B06 insert · stomach outlet illustration

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
UMP — Explain in her own voice, then land the personal realization.

CUT CUE: Anatomy insert on how fast your stomach empties; straight return at It was not a weight thing.

Timing provisional; this thought may span presenter coverage and short inserts.
STAGING: Brief simple stomach-to-small-intestine educational view for empties/contracts, then return to her for the recognition. No rotting-food, universal obstruction or gas-explosion depiction.
SELECTED FIRST FRAME: I03-stomach-emptying. GPT Image 2 still; motion and final voice alignment pending. Use only for the planned short insert; the matching car presenter carries the remaining narration.
Base performance is the one P01 HeyGen avatar; returns do not require a new presenter image.

Fiber / stool-water explanatory overlay

Reveal the matching panel on “fiber helps with regularity” and “MiraLAX moves water into the stool.” Remove at “I had completely missed that.” Keep the same avatar underneath. No generic bottles or efficacy scorecard.
Underlying performance: one continuous HeyGen avatar from P01. Cue timing stays provisional until actual voice alignment.

cards.title: TIMING & SCRIPT
cards.text: Exact supplied H1 + body: 892 words. 205 wpm planning pace with brief pauses; 4:34 including a 3-second end hold. 27 thought beats are not 27 cuts or generation clips. Preserve the script; align final cuts and captions to recorded words.

cards.text: Preserve source copy in planning. Before production, substantiate the physician/group accounts, ingredient mechanism and clinical claims, first-person results, exclusivity, availability and guarantee. Do not manufacture clinician posts or before/after proof.
